integrity: A self-contained proof with a standalone exhaustive checker for q=2,3,4,5. Literature comparisons are necessarily nonexhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Classifies conjugation orbits only in M_2(F_q), not higher dimensions; finite verification is illustrative, not an infinite certificate.
title: Classification of maximal nilpotent-free subspaces of two-by-two finite-field matrices
